speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Flat. The bed over the hall, and the shutter is shut. You will not improve the light.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: I know which bay. Richard and Sadler had you between them for the last of the lane, and you argued with every step and lost.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: You great fool. Lie still. I have you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is kinder than the plot.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The plot had an audience. This room does not. Stay where you are put.
